passives.name: Professor’s Dignity
passives.description: (Passive Effect) Recovers Priority and Health of the caster by 10% when attacking a target inflicted with a debuff. Additionally, increases damage dealt to targets inflicted with debuffs. After attacking, if the target is inflicted with a debuff, grants irremovable effects to the caster that increase Attack, Defense, and Speed for 2 turns. Reduces Weakness Gauge damage taken by 80% when Enraged.

passives.name: Blessing of the Tower of Flames
passives.description: Penetration is always increased by 20% and Critical Hit Chance by 10%. Damage taken is reduced by 20%. At end of turn, reduces the enemy team’s CP by 25.
